title: Enhancing Father's Ability to Support Their Preschool Child
brief_summary: This study focuses on the development of the Fathers Supporting Success in Preschoolers (FSSP) Program, which combines evidence-based parenting interventions with Dialogic Reading to engage fathers in and improve parenting and child behavior.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male Guardian
* Child enrolled in partnering Head Start site

Exclusion Criteria:

* Mental Health issues that prohibit involvement in group-based prevention study (e.g., psychosis)
